description: This file defines data structures, classes, constants, and macros related to trigger shape configuration and decoding in an engine control system. It particularly includes definitions for trigger shape, trigger events, synchronization, and angle calculations within a multi-channel trigger decoder context.

classes.name: event_trigger_position_s
classes.description: Represents a trigger event position with index, angle, and offset.

classes.name: trigger_shape_helper
classes.description: Helper class for managing trigger shape channels and pin states.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: Encapsulates the trigger shape model used to define and decode engine trigger signals, including timing, synchronization, and event handling.

methods.name: initializeTriggerShape
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with configuration parameters and logger.

methods.name: findTriggerPosition
methods.description: Calculates and finds the trigger position given an angle offset.

methods.name: calculateExpectedEventCounts
methods.description: Calculates expected trigger events for each signal channel based on configuration.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a trigger event at a specific angle, channel, and state.

methods.name: getOperationMode
methods.description: Returns the operation mode of the trigger shape.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Prepares the trigger shape for operation with specified mode and trigger input needs.

methods.name: setTriggerSynchronizationGap
methods.description: Sets the synchronization gap ratio for the trigger.

methods.name: setTriggerSynchronizationGap3
methods.description: Sets synchronization gaps with specific ratios for advanced trigger configurations.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of trigger events defined.
